title: Evaluations harness for editorial diagnose and rewrite options
description:
# Evaluations harness for editorial quality tooling

## Intent

Add regression evaluations so diagnose findings and rewrite-option quality can improve safely as the standalone tool evolves.

## Done when

- Fixture corpus of drafts + expected finding classes / acceptable option properties.
- Offline-friendly eval runner (deterministic where possible; LLM judges gated and versioned).
- Metrics tracked: precision/recall on finding types, unsupported-claim rate in options, human-accept proxy scores.
- CI can run a smoke subset without Papyrus.
- Documented how to add fixtures when Ryan rejects a bad suggestion.
